item.title: Meta's LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV — My Explanation and Thoughts
item.description: Understanding Meta's LLM-powered agentic recommendation system for Connected TV: LLM agents generate and rank timely topics, MediaBrain retrieves videos through Semantic IDs, traditional ML preserves precise ranking, and asynchronous caching keeps inference off the critical path.
